item.text:
### (a) Three posts

1. We are convinced: if anyone builds superintelligence with anything like current techniques, everyone on Earth will die. We demand a legally binding prohibition on its development. No company or government has the right to gamble with humanity’s survival.

2. We refuse to accept human extinction as the price of technological progress. Superintelligence built with anything like current techniques will kill everyone on Earth. We are organising for a legally binding prohibition before anyone builds it.

3. We want humanity to have a future. That means stopping the development of superintelligence—not trusting promises to make it safe. Built with anything like current techniques, it will kill us all. We demand a prohibition with the force of law.

### (b) Newsletter opening — 108 words

We are convinced that if anyone builds superintelligence with anything like current techniques, everyone on Earth will die. This conviction is why we exist, and why we demand a legally binding prohibition on its development. We will not accept humanity’s extinction as the price of a company’s ambition or a government’s race for advantage. No one knows how to build these systems safely. Promises, voluntary commitments and assurances cannot substitute for enforceable law. We are organising to stop this race before it reaches its destination. We want a future in which people can live, flourish and choose their own path—not one in which that future is destroyed.
